verdict.rationale: Vue.js is an open-source JS framework distributed as files/npm packages that developers host themselves; community evidence confirms trivial self-hosting ('download vue(.min).js and you are ready to go, no package manager needed'), and docs describe it as a standard HTML/CSS/JS-based library with no proprietary hosted service dependency. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party documentation section titled 'self-hosting' or discussion of self-hosting build tooling/SSR infrastructure at scale.
